fusions.name: Reaching Tendrils
fusions.desc: Sends out 8 tendrils of spores at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Squeeze
fusions.desc: Squeezes a target at or below 25% health for 14 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 0.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Mottled Cap
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds, and you move 10% faster while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You regain 12 health.

fusions.name: Inkcap Familiar
fusions.desc: A bonded inkcap familiar fights beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each strike leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
